ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80-85% low-intensity (black) to 15-20% high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white patch on the lateral section of the left lobe containing internal dark linear disruptions; diffuse, non-contiguous high-intensity speckled mottling on the upper-medial section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior pixel angle of 40-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; approximately 5-7 distinct peaks per lobe with low-amplitude irregular valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature along the upper trailing edges tapering into sharp, upward-projecting distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast (off-white/yellowish) pixel groups localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct, parallel vertical dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation patch on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation (barnacle colonies) present on the distal tips of both lobes; visible irregularity and potential pigment loss at the vertex of the median notch.
